gradient_norm_semantics: total gradient norm returned by clip_grad_norm_, before clipping

interpretation.loss: batch mean of per-anchor mean log1p(position error metres / 1000), including valid queries outside eligibility
interpretation.windows: fixed update windows use different sampled scenes and anchors; trends are not a fixed-population convergence test
interpretation.linear_error: mean linear training error cannot be recovered by expm1 of logged mean log loss
interpretation.exposure: visits count successful anchor draws; distinct fragments are not distinct target identities or complete epochs
interpretation.gradients: nonzero total norm does not establish per-parameter learning or exclude partial sigmoid saturation
interpretation.clipping: count of preclip norm > configured clip is not an exact count of gradient rescaling, which also uses a numerical epsilon
interpretation.zero_eligible: zero opportunity batches still consumed an optimizer step; retained Adam momentum may change parameters
interpretation.unavailable: no per-query training errors, gradient decomposition, gate/logit history or unexecuted candidate outcomes are reconstructed
